answer: Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. By the beacon of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. The design leans on cross-signed proof-of-personhood, expired if not renewed by fresh work, the unit of trust is a task, not an address. The kernel holds work receipts rather than names, so the wharf of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread.
